+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+"""Convert a released Inkling checkpoint (Hugging Face safetensors) to Megatron.
+
+    python tools/checkpoint_conversion/convert_inkling_hf_megatron.py \\
+        --hf-dir /data/Inkling-Small \\
+        --model-yaml primus/configs/models/megatron/inkling_small.yaml \\
+        --output /data/inkling_small_megatron [--dry-run]
+
+What it does:
+
+1. Checks the model preset against the checkpoint's ``config.json``.
+2. Builds the Megatron model on the meta device (no memory) to get the
+   expected parameter names and shapes.
+3. Maps every text-backbone tensor (``inkling_hf_mapping.iter_release_to_megatron``),
+   streaming one tensor at a time from the shards, and checks each against
+   step 2. ``model.mtp.*`` (multi-token prediction), ``model.visual.*`` and
+   ``model.audio.*`` are skipped.
+4. Writes a single-rank (TP=PP=EP=1) Megatron ``torch`` checkpoint under
+   ``<output>/release/mp_rank_00/model_optim_rng.pt``; load it with
+   ``--load <output> --ckpt-format torch --finetune --no-load-optim --no-load-rng``.
+
+The embedding and LM head are trimmed or zero-padded to the vocabulary size
+training builds: ``unpadded_vocab_size`` rounded up to a multiple of
+``--make-vocab-size-divisible-by`` x ``--tensor-model-parallel-size`` (128 x 1
+by default, matching ``trainer_base.yaml``). Pass the training run's values,
+or ``--target-vocab-size``, if they differ.
+
+``--dry-run`` stops after step 3, reading only the safetensors headers, so the
+full mapping can be validated on a login node. Writing a resharded
+``torch_dist`` checkpoint for multi-node runs is P3 work.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import socket
+import struct
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, Tuple
+
+_REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO))
+sys.path.append(str(_REPO / "third_party" / "Megatron-LM"))
+
+import torch  # noqa: E402
+
+_DTYPES = {"BF16": torch.bfloat16, "F16": torch.float16, "F32": torch.float32}
+
+# Kept in fp32 by Megatron (``TopKRouter._maintain_float32_expert_bias``).
+_FP32_SUFFIXES = (".mlp.router.expert_bias",)
+
+
+def read_safetensors_header(path: Path) -> Dict[str, Tuple[str, Tuple[int, ...]]]:
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        (n,) = struct.unpack("<Q", f.read(8))
+        header = json.loads(f.read(n))
+    return {k: (v["dtype"], tuple(v["shape"])) for k, v in header.items() if k != "__metadata__"}
+
+
+def checkpoint_index(hf_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    index = hf_dir / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+    if index.exists():
+        return json.loads(index.read_text())["weight_map"]
+    return {k: "model.safetensors" for k in read_safetensors_header(hf_dir / "model.safetensors")}
+
+
+def init_single_rank():
+    if not torch.distributed.is_initialized():
+        with socket.socket() as s:
+            s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+            port = s.getsockname()[1]
+        backend = "nccl" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "gloo"
+        torch.distributed.init_process_group(
+            backend, init_method=f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{port}", world_size=1, rank=0
+        )
+    from megatron.core import parallel_state as ps
+
+    if not ps.model_parallel_is_initialized():
+        ps.initialize_model_parallel(1, 1)
+
+
+def check_preset(config, text_config) -> None:
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_hf_mapping import (
+        megatron_config_from_release,
+    )
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_transformer_config import (
+        normalize_moe_layer_freq,
+    )
+
+    want = megatron_config_from_release(text_config)
+    want["moe_layer_freq"] = normalize_moe_layer_freq(want["moe_layer_freq"], num_layers=want["num_layers"])
+    want["num_moe_experts"] = want.pop("num_experts")
+    del want["vocab_size"]  # Megatron pads the tokenizer vocab its own way
+    bad = [
+        f"{key}: preset={getattr(config, key)!r} checkpoint={value!r}"
+        for key, value in want.items()
+        if getattr(config, key) != value
+    ]
+    if bad:
+        raise SystemExit("Model preset does not match the checkpoint:\n  " + "\n  ".join(bad))
+
+
+def main(argv=None) -> int:
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
+    p.add_argument("--hf-dir", required=True, type=Path)
+    p.add_argument("--model-yaml", required=True, type=Path)
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
+    p.add_argument(
+        "--target-vocab-size",
+        type=int,
+        default=None,
+        help="Megatron padded vocab (default: unpadded_vocab_size padded the way training pads it)",
+    )
+    p.add_argument("--make-vocab-size-divisible-by", type=int, default=128)
+    p.add_argument("--tensor-model-parallel-size", type=int, default=1)
+    p.add_argument("--dtype", choices=["bf16", "fp32"], default="bf16")
+    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="map shapes from the headers only; write nothing")
+    args = p.parse_args(argv)
+    if not args.dry_run and args.output is None:
+        p.error("--output is required unless --dry-run")
+
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_builders import (
+        build_inkling_model,
+        inkling_config_from_model_yaml,
+    )
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_hf_mapping import (
+        InklingGeometry,
+        iter_release_to_megatron,
+        module_tensor_shapes,
+        release_text_keys,
+    )
+
+    text_config = json.loads((args.hf_dir / "config.json").read_text()).get("text_config")
+    weight_map = checkpoint_index(args.hf_dir)
+
+    init_single_rank()
+    config = inkling_config_from_model_yaml(str(args.model_yaml))
+    check_preset(config, text_config)
+    geo = InklingGeometry.from_megatron_config(config)
+
+    headers: Dict[str, Tuple[str, Tuple[int, ...]]] = {}
+    for shard in sorted(set(weight_map.values())):
+        headers.update(read_safetensors_header(args.hf_dir / shard))
+    vocab_rows = headers["model.llm.embed.weight"][1][0]
+    unpadded = config.unpadded_vocab_size or vocab_rows
+    multiple = args.make_vocab_size_divisible_by * args.tensor_model_parallel_size
+    target_vocab = args.target_vocab_size or -(-unpadded // multiple) * multiple
+    if target_vocab < unpadded:
+        raise SystemExit(f"--target-vocab-size {target_vocab} would drop real tokens (unpadded {unpadded})")
+    print(f"[inkling-convert] vocab: {vocab_rows} checkpoint rows -> {target_vocab} (unpadded {unpadded})")
+
+    model = build_inkling_model(config, vocab_size=target_vocab, max_sequence_length=4096, meta=True)
+    expected = module_tensor_shapes(model)
+    extra_state = [k for k in model.state_dict() if k.endswith("_extra_state")]
+    del model
+
+    text_keys = release_text_keys(weight_map)
+    used = set()
+    handles = {}
+
+    def meta_get(name):
+        used.add(name)
+        dtype, shape = headers[name]
+        return torch.empty(shape, dtype=_DTYPES[dtype], device="meta")
+
+    def real_get(name):
+        from safetensors import safe_open
+
+        used.add(name)
+        shard = weight_map[name]
+        if shard not in handles:
+            handles[shard] = safe_open(str(args.hf_dir / shard), framework="pt")
+        return handles[shard].get_tensor(name)
+
+    out_dtype = torch.bfloat16 if args.dtype == "bf16" else torch.float32
+    state = {}
+    seen = set()
+    for key, tensor in iter_release_to_megatron(
+        meta_get if args.dry_run else real_get, geo, target_vocab_size=target_vocab
+    ):
+        if key not in expected:
+            raise SystemExit(f"converter produced {key}, which the Megatron model does not have")
+        if tuple(tensor.shape) != expected[key]:
+            raise SystemExit(f"{key}: converted {tuple(tensor.shape)} != model {expected[key]}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        if not args.dry_run:
+            dtype = torch.float32 if key.endswith(_FP32_SUFFIXES) else out_dtype
+            state[key] = tensor.to(dtype).contiguous().clone()
+
+    missing = sorted(set(expected) - seen)
+    unmapped = sorted(text_keys - used)
+    skipped = sorted(set(weight_map) - text_keys)
+    print(
+        f"[inkling-convert] mapped {len(used)} released tensors -> {len(seen)} Megatron tensors; "
+        f"skipped {len(skipped)} non-text tensors (MTP / vision / audio)"
+    )
+    if missing or unmapped:
+        raise SystemExit(
+            f"incomplete mapping: model keys without a source {missing[:5]}, unmapped sources {unmapped[:5]}"
+        )
+    if args.dry_run:
+        print("[inkling-convert] dry run OK: every text tensor maps one-to-one onto the Megatron model")
+        return 0
+
+    for key in extra_state:
+        state[key] = None
+    ckpt_dir = args.output / "release" / "mp_rank_00"
+    os.makedirs(ckpt_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    torch.save({"model": state, "checkpoint_version": 3.0, "iteration": 0}, ckpt_dir / "model_optim_rng.pt")
+    (args.output / "latest_checkpointed_iteration.txt").write_text("release")
+    print(f"[inkling-convert] wrote {ckpt_dir / 'model_optim_rng.pt'}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Inkling self-attention (``InklingAttention`` in ``modeling_inkling.py``).
+
+What one layer holds:
+
+* ``linear_qkv`` -- q, k, v in Megatron's own fused layout: rows grouped per
+  KV head (``[q heads of g | k_g | v_g]``), so a contiguous TP split hands each
+  rank whole groups and Megatron tooling (e.g. Muon's ``qkv_split_shapes``)
+  reads it unchanged. ``fuse_qkv`` / ``split_qkv`` in ``inkling_hf_mapping.py``
+  own the layout.
+* ``linear_rel`` -- the relative states r (``d_rel`` per q head), a separate
+  column-parallel GEMM on the same input; its contiguous TP split lines up with
+  the rank's q heads.
+* ``q_layernorm`` / ``k_layernorm`` -- per-head RMSNorm; no RoPE.
+* ``k_sconv`` / ``v_sconv`` -- short convs on K and V (TP-sharded channels),
+  applied before the K norm.
+* ``rel_proj`` -- ``[d_rel, rel_extent]`` bank of bias-vs-distance profiles;
+  ``rel_extent`` is ``sliding_window_size`` on sliding layers.
+* ``linear_proj`` -- the output projection.
+
+The sliding and global layers can have different head geometry
+(``swa_*``), so each layer builds from
+:meth:`InklingTransformerConfig.attention_config`.
+
+The score of query ``t`` on key ``u`` (``d = t - u``) is::
+
+    q_t . k_u / head_dim + [0 <= d < rel_extent] * (r_t @ rel_proj)[h, d]
+
+masked to ``0 <= d`` (global) or ``0 <= d < window`` (sliding). Global
+layers multiply q and the bias by ``1 + alpha * log(max(1, (t + 1) / floor))``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional, Union
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.transformer.attention import Attention, SelfAttentionSubmodules
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import AttnMaskType
+from megatron.core.transformer.module import MegatronModule
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.inkling.short_conv import (
+    InklingShortConv,
+)
+
+try:
+    from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import create_block_mask, flex_attention
+except ImportError:  # torch < 2.5
+    create_block_mask = flex_attention = None
+
+__all__ = [
+    "InklingSelfAttention",
+    "InklingSelfAttentionSubmodules",
+    "InklingCoreAttention",
+    "inkling_log_scale",
+]
+
+_FLEX = None
+_BLOCK_MASKS = {}
+
+
+def _compiled_flex_attention():
+    global _FLEX
+    if _FLEX is None:
+        _FLEX = torch.compile(flex_attention, dynamic=False)
+    return _FLEX
+
+
+def _inkling_block_mask(seq_len: int, batch: int, window: Optional[int], device, attention_mask=None):
+    """Causal (``window=None``) or causal + ``window`` block mask, cached per shape.
+
+    A Megatron ``attention_mask`` (``True`` = masked, broadcastable to
+    ``[b, 1, s, s]``) is folded in per batch row; that mask is rebuilt every call.
+    """
+    key = (seq_len, window, str(device))
+    if attention_mask is None and key in _BLOCK_MASKS:
+        return _BLOCK_MASKS[key]
+    extra = None if attention_mask is None else attention_mask.bool().expand(batch, 1, seq_len, seq_len)
+
+    def mask_mod(b_idx, h_idx, q_idx, kv_idx):
+        allowed = q_idx >= kv_idx
+        if window is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & (q_idx - kv_idx < window)
+        if extra is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & ~extra[b_idx, 0, q_idx, kv_idx]
+        return allowed
+
+    mask = create_block_mask(
+        mask_mod, None if extra is None else batch, None, seq_len, seq_len, device=device
+    )
+    if extra is None:
+        _BLOCK_MASKS[key] = mask
+    return mask
+
+
+def inkling_log_scale(seq_len: int, n_floor: int, alpha: float, device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``tau[t] = 1 + alpha * log(max(1, (t + 1) / n_floor))`` in fp32, shape ``[seq_len]``."""
+    n = torch.arange(1, seq_len + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    return 1.0 + alpha * torch.log((n / n_floor).clamp(min=1.0))
+
+
+class InklingCoreAttention(MegatronModule):
+    """Softmax attention with the relative-logit bias. Holds no parameters.
+
+    ``eager`` materialises the ``[b, heads, s, s]`` bias and scores; it is the
+    numerical reference for the FlexAttention backend. ``flex`` adds the bias
+    in a ``score_mod`` that reads ``rel_logits[b, h, t, t - u]`` and skips
+    masked tiles through a block mask, so no ``[s, s]`` tensor is stored.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config,
+        layer_number: int,
+        attn_mask_type: AttnMaskType,
+        attention_type: str = "self",
+        cp_comm_type: Optional[str] = None,
+        softmax_scale: Optional[float] = None,
+        pg_collection=None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        geo = config.attention_geometry(layer_number - 1)
+        self.layer_number = layer_number
+        self.attn_mask_type = attn_mask_type
+        self.softmax_scale = softmax_scale if softmax_scale is not None else 1.0 / geo["kv_channels"]
+        self.window = geo["window"]
+        self.rel_extent = geo["rel_extent"]
+        self.is_sliding = geo["sliding"]
+        self.log_scaling = (not self.is_sliding) and config.log_scaling_n_floor is not None
+        self.backend = config.inkling_attention_backend
+        self.dropout_p = config.attention_dropout
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        rel_states: torch.Tensor,
+        rel_proj: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``query`` ``[s, b, h, d]``, ``key``/``value`` ``[s, b, g, d]``,
+        ``rel_states`` ``[s, b, h, d_rel]``; returns ``[s, b, h * d]``.
+
+        ``attention_mask`` is Megatron's boolean mask (``True`` = masked),
+        broadcastable to ``[b, 1, s, s]``; it is combined with the causal and
+        window masks.
+        """
+        if self.backend == "flex":
+            return self._flex(query, key, value, rel_states, rel_proj, attention_mask)
+        return self._eager(query, key, value, rel_states, rel_proj, attention_mask)
+
+    def _rel_logits_and_query(self, query, rel_states, rel_proj):
+        """``q`` ``[b, h, s, d]`` and ``rel_logits`` ``[b, h, s, rel_extent]``, log-scaled on global layers."""
+        s = query.shape[0]
+        q = query.permute(1, 2, 0, 3)
+        rel_logits = torch.matmul(rel_states, rel_proj).permute(1, 2, 0, 3)
+        if self.log_scaling:
+            tau = inkling_log_scale(
+                s, self.config.log_scaling_n_floor, self.config.log_scaling_alpha, query.device
+            ).view(1, 1, s, 1)
+            q = (q.float() * tau).to(q.dtype)
+            rel_logits = (rel_logits.float() * tau).to(rel_logits.dtype)
+        return q, rel_logits
+
+    def _flex(self, query, key, value, rel_states, rel_proj, attention_mask):
+        if flex_attention is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("inkling_attention_backend: flex needs torch.nn.attention.flex_attention")
+        if self.training and self.dropout_p > 0:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Inkling's flex attention does not support attention dropout")
+        s, b, h, d = query.shape
+        g = key.shape[2]
+        q, rel_logits = self._rel_logits_and_query(query, rel_states, rel_proj)
+        rel_extent = self.rel_extent
+
+        def score_mod(score, b_idx, h_idx, q_idx, kv_idx):
+            distance = q_idx - kv_idx
+            bias = rel_logits[b_idx, h_idx, q_idx, distance.clamp(0, rel_extent - 1)]
+            return torch.where((distance >= 0) & (distance < rel_extent), score + bias.to(score.dtype), score)
+
+        out = _compiled_flex_attention()(
+            q,
+            key.permute(1, 2, 0, 3),
+            value.permute(1, 2, 0, 3),
+            score_mod=score_mod,
+            block_mask=_inkling_block_mask(s, b, self.window, query.device, attention_mask),
+            scale=self.softmax_scale,
+            enable_gqa=h != g,
+        )
+        return out.permute(2, 0, 1, 3).reshape(s, b, h * d)
+
+    def _eager(self, query, key, value, rel_states, rel_proj, attention_mask):
+        s, b, h, d = query.shape
+        g = key.shape[2]
+        q, rel_logits = self._rel_logits_and_query(query, rel_states, rel_proj)
+        k = key.permute(1, 2, 0, 3).repeat_interleave(h // g, dim=1)
+        v = value.permute(1, 2, 0, 3).repeat_interleave(h // g, dim=1)
+
+        pos = torch.arange(s, device=query.device)
+        distance = pos[:, None] - pos[None, :]
+        index = distance.clamp(0, self.rel_extent - 1).expand(b, h, s, s)
+        bias = rel_logits.gather(-1, index)
+        bias = bias.masked_fill((distance < 0) | (distance >= self.rel_extent), 0.0)
+
+        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) * self.softmax_scale + bias
+        allowed = distance >= 0
+        if self.window is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & (distance < self.window)
+        if attention_mask is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & ~attention_mask.bool()
+        scores = scores.masked_fill(~allowed, torch.finfo(scores.dtype).min)
+
+        probs = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(q.dtype)

+###############################################################################

+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Inkling's depthwise causal short convolution with a residual.
+
+``y = x + conv1d_causal(x)`` per channel, computed in fp32
+(``InklingShortConvolution`` in ``modeling_inkling.py``). Inkling applies
+it to K and V inside attention, and to the attention and MLP outputs before
+each residual add.
+
+The weight keeps the checkpoint's ``nn.Conv1d`` layout ``[channels, 1,
+kernel]`` so the importer copies it unchanged.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from megatron.core.transformer.module import MegatronModule
+
+__all__ = ["InklingShortConv"]
+
+
+class InklingShortConv(MegatronModule):
+    """Depthwise causal conv + residual over the last dim of ``[s, b, c]``.
+
+    Args:
+        config: transformer config (for ``params_dtype``).
+        channels: channels held on this rank.
+        kernel_size: conv taps.
+        tensor_parallel: the channels are a TP shard (K/V convs); the
+            attention/MLP output convs act on the full hidden size and are
+            replicated.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config, channels: int, kernel_size: int, tensor_parallel: bool = False):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        self.channels = channels
+        self.kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(channels, 1, kernel_size, dtype=config.params_dtype))
+        if tensor_parallel:
+            self.weight.tensor_model_parallel = True
+            self.weight.partition_dim = 0
+            self.weight.partition_stride = 1
+        else:
+            setattr(self.weight, "sequence_parallel", config.sequence_parallel)
+        self.reset_parameters()
+
+    def reset_parameters(self):
+        if self.weight.device.type != "meta" and self.config.perform_initialization:
+            self.config.init_method(self.weight)
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, seq_lengths: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``x``: ``[s, b, c]``. Packed sequences (``seq_lengths``) are optional item O8."""
+        if seq_lengths is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Packed-sequence short convolution is optional item O8")
+        in_dtype = x.dtype
+        xf = x.float()
+        h = xf.permute(1, 2, 0)  # [b, c, s]
+        out = F.conv1d(h, self.weight.float(), padding=self.kernel_size - 1, groups=self.channels)

+layers 1-7, global attention on layers 3 and 7) through Megatron's pipeline

+Each rank loads its slice of the reference weights through the importer. The
+global loss and every gradient, summed over data-parallel ranks the way the

+What one layer holds:
+
+* ``linear_qkv`` -- q, k, v in Megatron's own fused layout: rows grouped per
+  KV head (``[q heads of g | k_g | v_g]``), so a contiguous TP split hands each
+  rank whole groups and Megatron tooling (e.g. Muon's ``qkv_split_shapes``)
+  reads it unchanged. ``fuse_qkv`` / ``split_qkv`` in ``inkling_hf_mapping.py``
+  own the layout.
+* ``linear_rel`` -- the relative states r (``d_rel`` per q head), a separate
+  column-parallel GEMM on the same input; its contiguous TP split lines up with
+  the rank's q heads.
+* ``q_layernorm`` / ``k_layernorm`` -- per-head RMSNorm; no RoPE.
+* ``k_sconv`` / ``v_sconv`` -- short convs on K and V (TP-sharded channels),
+  applied before the K norm.
+* ``rel_proj`` -- ``[d_rel, rel_extent]`` bank of bias-vs-distance profiles;
+  ``rel_extent`` is ``sliding_window_size`` on sliding layers.
+* ``linear_proj`` -- the output projection.
+

+(``swa_*``), so each layer builds from
+:meth:`InklingTransformerConfig.attention_config`.

+The score of query ``t`` on key ``u`` (``d = t - u``) is::
+
+    q_t . k_u / head_dim + [0 <= d < rel_extent] * (r_t @ rel_proj)[h, d]

+        allowed = q_idx >= kv_idx
+        if window is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & (q_idx - kv_idx < window)
+        if extra is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & ~extra[b_idx, 0, q_idx, kv_idx]
+        return allowed
+
+    mask = create_block_mask(
+        mask_mod, None if extra is None else batch, None, seq_len, seq_len, device=device
+    )
+    if extra is None:
+        _BLOCK_MASKS[key] = mask
+    return mask
+
+
+def inkling_log_scale(seq_len: int, n_floor: int, alpha: float, device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``tau[t] = 1 + alpha * log(max(1, (t + 1) / n_floor))`` in fp32, shape ``[seq_len]``."""
+    n = torch.arange(1, seq_len + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    return 1.0 + alpha * torch.log((n / n_floor).clamp(min=1.0))
+
+
+class InklingCoreAttention(MegatronModule):
+    """Softmax attention with the relative-logit bias. Holds no parameters.
+
+    ``eager`` materialises the ``[b, heads, s, s]`` bias and scores; it is the
+    numerical reference for the FlexAttention backend. ``flex`` adds the bias
+    in a ``score_mod`` that reads ``rel_logits[b, h, t, t - u]`` and skips
+    masked tiles through a block mask, so no ``[s, s]`` tensor is stored.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config,
+        layer_number: int,
+        attn_mask_type: AttnMaskType,
+        attention_type: str = "self",
+        cp_comm_type: Optional[str] = None,
+        softmax_scale: Optional[float] = None,
+        pg_collection=None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        geo = config.attention_geometry(layer_number - 1)
+        self.layer_number = layer_number
+        self.attn_mask_type = attn_mask_type
+        self.softmax_scale = softmax_scale if softmax_scale is not None else 1.0 / geo["kv_channels"]
+        self.window = geo["window"]
+        self.rel_extent = geo["rel_extent"]
+        self.is_sliding = geo["sliding"]
+        self.log_scaling = (not self.is_sliding) and config.log_scaling_n_floor is not None
+        self.backend = config.inkling_attention_backend
+        self.dropout_p = config.attention_dropout
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        rel_states: torch.Tensor,
+        rel_proj: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``query`` ``[s, b, h, d]``, ``key``/``value`` ``[s, b, g, d]``,
+        ``rel_states`` ``[s, b, h, d_rel]``; returns ``[s, b, h * d]``.
+
+        ``attention_mask`` is Megatron's boolean mask (``True`` = masked),
+        broadcastable to ``[b, 1, s, s]``; it is combined with the causal and
+        window masks.
+        """
+        if self.backend == "flex":
+            return self._flex(query, key, value, rel_states, rel_proj, attention_mask)
+        return self._eager(query, key, value, rel_states, rel_proj, attention_mask)
+
+    def _rel_logits_and_query(self, query, rel_states, rel_proj):
+        """``q`` ``[b, h, s, d]`` and ``rel_logits`` ``[b, h, s, rel_extent]``, log-scaled on global layers."""
+        s = query.shape[0]
+        q = query.permute(1, 2, 0, 3)
+        rel_logits = torch.matmul(rel_states, rel_proj).permute(1, 2, 0, 3)
+        if self.log_scaling:
+            tau = inkling_log_scale(
+                s, self.config.log_scaling_n_floor, self.config.log_scaling_alpha, query.device
+            ).view(1, 1, s, 1)
+            q = (q.float() * tau).to(q.dtype)
+            rel_logits = (rel_logits.float() * tau).to(rel_logits.dtype)
+        return q, rel_logits
+
+    def _flex(self, query, key, value, rel_states, rel_proj, attention_mask):
+        if flex_attention is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("inkling_attention_backend: flex needs torch.nn.attention.flex_attention")
+        if self.training and self.dropout_p > 0:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Inkling's flex attention does not support attention dropout")
+        s, b, h, d = query.shape
+        g = key.shape[2]
+        q, rel_logits = self._rel_logits_and_query(query, rel_states, rel_proj)
+        rel_extent = self.rel_extent
+
+        def score_mod(score, b_idx, h_idx, q_idx, kv_idx):
+            distance = q_idx - kv_idx
+            bias = rel_logits[b_idx, h_idx, q_idx, distance.clamp(0, rel_extent - 1)]
+            return torch.where((distance >= 0) & (distance < rel_extent), score + bias.to(score.dtype), score)
+
+        out = _compiled_flex_attention()(
+            q,
+            key.permute(1, 2, 0, 3),
+            value.permute(1, 2, 0, 3),
+            score_mod=score_mod,
+            block_mask=_inkling_block_mask(s, b, self.window, query.device, attention_mask),
+            scale=self.softmax_scale,
+            enable_gqa=h != g,
+        )
+        return out.permute(2, 0, 1, 3).reshape(s, b, h * d)
+
+    def _eager(self, query, key, value, rel_states, rel_proj, attention_mask):
+        s, b, h, d = query.shape
+        g = key.shape[2]
+        q, rel_logits = self._rel_logits_and_query(query, rel_states, rel_proj)
+        k = key.permute(1, 2, 0, 3).repeat_interleave(h // g, dim=1)
+        v = value.permute(1, 2, 0, 3).repeat_interleave(h // g, dim=1)
+
+        pos = torch.arange(s, device=query.device)
+        distance = pos[:, None] - pos[None, :]
+        index = distance.clamp(0, self.rel_extent - 1).expand(b, h, s, s)
+        bias = rel_logits.gather(-1, index)
+        bias = bias.masked_fill((distance < 0) | (distance >= self.rel_extent), 0.0)
+
+        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) * self.softmax_scale + bias
+        allowed = distance >= 0
+        if self.window is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & (distance < self.window)
+        if attention_mask is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & ~attention_mask.bool()
+        scores = scores.masked_fill(~allowed, torch.finfo(scores.dtype).min)
+
+        probs = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(q.dtype)

+
+"""Inkling's depthwise causal short convolution with a residual.
+
+``y = x + conv1d_causal(x)`` per channel, computed in fp32
+(``InklingShortConvolution`` in ``modeling_inkling.py``). Inkling applies
+it to K and V inside attention, and to the attention and MLP outputs before
+each residual add.
+
+The weight keeps the checkpoint's ``nn.Conv1d`` layout ``[channels, 1,
+kernel]`` so the importer copies it unchanged.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from megatron.core.transformer.module import MegatronModule
+
+__all__ = ["InklingShortConv"]
+
+
+class InklingShortConv(MegatronModule):
+    """Depthwise causal conv + residual over the last dim of ``[s, b, c]``.
+
+    Args:
+        config: transformer config (for ``params_dtype``).
+        channels: channels held on this rank.
+        kernel_size: conv taps.
+        tensor_parallel: the channels are a TP shard (K/V convs); the
+            attention/MLP output convs act on the full hidden size and are
+            replicated.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config, channels: int, kernel_size: int, tensor_parallel: bool = False):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        self.channels = channels
+        self.kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(channels, 1, kernel_size, dtype=config.params_dtype))
+        if tensor_parallel:
+            self.weight.tensor_model_parallel = True
+            self.weight.partition_dim = 0
+            self.weight.partition_stride = 1
+        else:
+            setattr(self.weight, "sequence_parallel", config.sequence_parallel)
+        self.reset_parameters()
+
+    def reset_parameters(self):
+        if self.weight.device.type != "meta" and self.config.perform_initialization:
+            self.config.init_method(self.weight)
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, seq_lengths: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``x``: ``[s, b, c]``. Packed sequences (``seq_lengths``) are optional item O8."""
+        if seq_lengths is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Packed-sequence short convolution is optional item O8")
+        in_dtype = x.dtype
+        xf = x.float()
+        h = xf.permute(1, 2, 0)  # [b, c, s]
+        out = F.conv1d(h, self.weight.float(), padding=self.kernel_size - 1, groups=self.channels)

+"""Multi-GPU parity: Megatron Inkling under DP / EP / PP / VPP against the official model.
+
+Run with ``torchrun --nproc-per-node 8`` (needs the reference, see
+``inkling_reference.py``)::
+
+    PYTHONPATH=/tmp/inkling_ref/site torchrun --nproc-per-node 8 \\
+        tests/unit_tests/backends/megatron/inkling/parallel_reference_check.py
+
+Every layout trains one step of an 8-layer fp32 Inkling (dense layer 0, MoE
+layers 1-7, global attention on layers 3 and 7) through Megatron's pipeline
+schedules on a fixed 16 x 256-token batch split over the data-parallel ranks.
+Each rank loads its slice of the reference weights through the importer. The
+global loss and every gradient, summed over data-parallel ranks the way the
+DDP buckets would, are compared with the reference run in fp64 on the full
+batch. A gradient passes if its error (max |diff| relative to the tensor's
+max) is below 1e-5. The one-element ``global_scale`` gradients sum thousands
+of cancelling terms, so their fp32 rounding depends on the data and on how

+    rows = ids[rank * num_microbatches : (rank + 1) * num_microbatches]

+def _run_layout(name, pp, vpp, ep, backend, ids, ref_loss, ref_grads, ref32_errors, weights):
+    ps.destroy_model_parallel()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+###############################################################################

+###############################################################################
+"""Convert a released Inkling checkpoint (Hugging Face safetensors) to Megatron.
+
+    python tools/checkpoint_conversion/convert_inkling_hf_megatron.py \\
+        --hf-dir /data/Inkling-Small \\
+        --model-yaml primus/configs/models/megatron/inkling_small.yaml \\
+        --output /data/inkling_small_megatron [--dry-run]
+
+What it does:
+
+1. Checks the model preset against the checkpoint's ``config.json``.
+2. Builds the Megatron model on the meta device (no memory) to get the
+   expected parameter names and shapes.
+3. Maps every text-backbone tensor (``inkling_hf_mapping.iter_release_to_megatron``),
+   streaming one tensor at a time from the shards, and checks each against
+   step 2. ``model.mtp.*`` (multi-token prediction), ``model.visual.*`` and
+   ``model.audio.*`` are skipped.
+4. Writes a single-rank (TP=PP=EP=1) Megatron ``torch`` checkpoint under
+   ``<output>/release/mp_rank_00/model_optim_rng.pt``; load it with
+   ``--load <output> --ckpt-format torch --finetune --no-load-optim --no-load-rng``.
+
+``--dry-run`` stops after step 3, reading only the safetensors headers, so the
+full mapping can be validated on a login node. Writing a resharded
+``torch_dist`` checkpoint for multi-node runs is P3 work.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import socket
+import struct
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, Tuple
+
+_REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO))
+sys.path.append(str(_REPO / "third_party" / "Megatron-LM"))
+
+import torch  # noqa: E402
+
+_DTYPES = {"BF16": torch.bfloat16, "F16": torch.float16, "F32": torch.float32}
+
+# Kept in fp32 by Megatron (``TopKRouter._maintain_float32_expert_bias``).

+
+
+def read_safetensors_header(path: Path) -> Dict[str, Tuple[str, Tuple[int, ...]]]:
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        (n,) = struct.unpack("<Q", f.read(8))
+        header = json.loads(f.read(n))
+    return {k: (v["dtype"], tuple(v["shape"])) for k, v in header.items() if k != "__metadata__"}
+
+
+def checkpoint_index(hf_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    index = hf_dir / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+    if index.exists():
+        return json.loads(index.read_text())["weight_map"]
+    return {k: "model.safetensors" for k in read_safetensors_header(hf_dir / "model.safetensors")}
+
+
+def init_single_rank():
+    if not torch.distributed.is_initialized():
+        with socket.socket() as s:
+            s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+            port = s.getsockname()[1]
+        backend = "nccl" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "gloo"
+        torch.distributed.init_process_group(
+            backend, init_method=f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{port}", world_size=1, rank=0
+        )
+    from megatron.core import parallel_state as ps

+def check_preset(config, text_config) -> None:

+        megatron_config_from_release,
+    )
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_transformer_config import (
+        normalize_moe_layer_freq,
+    )

+    want["num_moe_experts"] = want.pop("num_experts")
+    del want["vocab_size"]  # Megatron pads the tokenizer vocab its own way
+    bad = [
+        f"{key}: preset={getattr(config, key)!r} checkpoint={value!r}"
+        for key, value in want.items()
+        if getattr(config, key) != value
+    ]
+    if bad:
+        raise SystemExit("Model preset does not match the checkpoint:\n  " + "\n  ".join(bad))
+
+
+def main(argv=None) -> int:
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
+    p.add_argument("--hf-dir", required=True, type=Path)
+    p.add_argument("--model-yaml", required=True, type=Path)
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
+    p.add_argument(
+        "--target-vocab-size", type=int, default=None, help="Megatron padded vocab (default: checkpoint rows)"
+    )
+    p.add_argument("--dtype", choices=["bf16", "fp32"], default="bf16")
+    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="map shapes from the headers only; write nothing")
+    args = p.parse_args(argv)
+    if not args.dry_run and args.output is None:
+        p.error("--output is required unless --dry-run")
+
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_builders import (
+        build_inkling_model,
+        inkling_config_from_model_yaml,
+    )
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.inkling.inkling_hf_mapping import (
+        InklingGeometry,
+        iter_release_to_megatron,
+        module_tensor_shapes,
+        release_text_keys,
+    )
+
+    text_config = json.loads((args.hf_dir / "config.json").read_text()).get("text_config")
+    weight_map = checkpoint_index(args.hf_dir)
+
+    init_single_rank()
+    config = inkling_config_from_model_yaml(str(args.model_yaml))
+    check_preset(config, text_config)
+    geo = InklingGeometry.from_megatron_config(config)
+
+    headers: Dict[str, Tuple[str, Tuple[int, ...]]] = {}
+    for shard in sorted(set(weight_map.values())):
+        headers.update(read_safetensors_header(args.hf_dir / shard))
+    vocab_rows = headers["model.llm.embed.weight"][1][0]
+    target_vocab = args.target_vocab_size or vocab_rows
